Tutorial1: ^We appreciate you deciding to help us out, most poeple are injured after the monster attacks.
^Lets walk you through our process here, then we can get cooking!
^To start head over to the order board by the door.
Tutorial2: ^This is the order board. Here is where citizens will post requests for food.
^They'll list what they want, so pick which order you want to work on but be careful.
^Each request takes time and you have limited resources.
^Looks like there is one request on the board. Go ahead and grab that first order.
Tutorial3: ^Great, looks like a citizen wants something that can get them going with some spice!
^They will walk up to the counter to wait for you to make the meal.
^Lets go cook a meal at the cooking station back in the other room.
^When a quest is active it's information will display at the top for reference.
Tutorial4: ^Alright now were ready to cook, there are two things to do.
^First you pick a meal type, for now you only have one option.
^Meals have different attributes and sometimes base spice levels.
^Once you have picked a meal, you have to balance the flavor.
^Select spices to reach the spice levels that they want.
^Spices levels increase every 20 points you put in.
^With all of that covered lets go ahead and make that meal!
^Balance the spice levels based on what the citizen wants...
Tutorial5: ^Nice, that's looking good, I hope the citizen likes it.
^Go up to the counter and talk to them. They'll assess the meal and decide if they like it.
Tutorial6True: ^Great job! You made a meal that they liked!
^When citizens like the meals they will consider a favor which increases your renown with their group.
^Doing favors and increasing renown is how we can help the town.
^This will cause the town to help us as well.
^Be careful though, neglecting relationships causes decline.
^Decline could take down the village forever.

Tutorial7: ^As you can see that took a little bit. This equipment is rusty...
^The watch I gave you will help you track the time so you know when the day is over.
^Since we started later in the day we've already run out of time to do more orders.
^So you'll be able to get started the next day.
^Ingredients replenish and you can continue making things.
^Go ahead and walk out the door to end the day and get started again tomorrow.
